hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Destocking x Smoothed Volume Synergy (10-Day Customer Decay)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Candidate 6599767a achieved Sharpe 1.23 (missing 1.25 cutoff by just 0.02!) with zero fundamental fields and zero portfolio correlation. Extending customer return decay from 5 to 10 days captures the full multi-tier inventory replenishment cycle while smoothing volume participation over 5 days. Expected to push Sharpe >= 1.45 while keeping self-correlation < 0.35.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during macroeconomic supply shocks where customer signals decouple from production schedules.

hypotheses.title: Linear Rank Combination of Supply Chain Destocking & Volume Participation
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Multiplicative rank interaction squashes intermediate percentiles (mean 0.25). A linear 70/30 combination of 10-day decayed customer return mean-reversion with 5-day decayed volume participation preserves the full uniform rank gradient across TOP3000, boosting Sharpe and Fitness while retaining zero fundamental correlation.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if volume participation component suffers sudden turnover inflation.

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Destocking x Direct Relative Volume Intensity Synergy
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines 10-day decayed supply chain customer mean-reversion with immediate daily volume relative to 20-day ADV. Direct relative volume captures urgent institutional trade execution against mean-reverting supplier inventory. Zero overlap with existing portfolio.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails when volume surges reflect corporate secondary offerings rather than active market flow.
